full_judgment: 3. Evidence led before the trial Court is that the disputed land, along with other lands, originally belonged to Manindra Shushan Chakraborty who left the then Pakistan about 25 years ago and that all his landed property including the disputed land became enemy property, subsequently treated as vested property by the Government. Name of Manindra Bhushan Mukherjee was recorded in both the R. S. Khartian and S. A. Khatian. It is this land which was settled to the complainant. Aminuddin (P.W. 1) by the Sub Divisional Officer. Evidence further shows that the complainant went into possession of the land. But it is this very land which accused-respondent Hanif Sheikh also claimed on the basis of a sale certificate whose Photocopy he produced before the Thana Revenue Officer (P.W.3) for the purpose of mutation. A number of witnesses were examined including P.W. 7, an Assaintant of Manikganj Munsif Court, in connection with the Execution Register No. 23/63, along with the connected Execution Case No. 21 of 1963. PW. 7 produced the relevant Execution Register of the Munsif Court. Manikganj. He doposed in the trial Court referring to the Execution register which showed that the Execution Case was dismissed for default on 26 August 1963, and that the parties were Shirish Candra Roy. the decree holder and Sheikh Sital the Judgment debtor, whereas the Photostat-copy showed that the Execution Case was disposed of by sale of the land in auction. Moreover, though Manindra Bhushan was the recorded owner of the land, he was not shown as the Judgment debtor in the Execution Register.
